personality_one_liner: A live operational surface that feels sharp, tactical, and performance-oriented, prioritizing immediate hierarchy and fast scanning.

spacing.rule: Use tight, rigid spacing grids to create an operational command-center feel. Rely on dividers and padding rather than empty whitespace to separate modules.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary for elevation instead of blur.
Use dividers and tonal separation to maintain high contrast and clarity.
dont's: Avoid glassmorphism entirely, as this utility demands peak performance, clarity, and zero decorative friction.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure entry point for accessing remote devices.

states.error: Inline error messaging above the login CTA.

screens.layout: Minimalist single-column layout. Form fields use surfaceTertiary background with no floating labels. Submit button anchored cleanly below inputs. Use the hero_datacenter abstract image heavily scrimmed at the top.

screens.name: DevicesList
screens.purpose: Dashboard to monitor and quickly connect to all remote agents.

states.empty: Illustration of a disconnected server rack, short message, and 'Add Device' primary CTA.
states.error: Full-screen error with a prominent 'Retry Connection' button.

screens.layout: Card-based layout (single column). Each card displays Device ID in display font (Rajdhani), uptime/last seen metrics, a strict online/offline indicator dot, and a prominent 'Connect' action. The layout must feel like a live metrics dashboard. Bottom tab navigation.

screens.name: AddDevice
screens.purpose: Provide instructions and codes to securely pair a new remote desktop.

states.loading: Spinner over the pairing code area.
states.error: Toast or inline message for code generation failure.

screens.layout: Step-by-step instructions. The Pairing Code / OTP must dominate the screen using the 2xl display typography, wrapped in a surfaceTertiary block with a borderStrong outline for emphasis. Include a quick 'Copy' button.

screens.name: RemoteViewer
screens.purpose: Immersive, full-screen live view of the remote desktop with overlay controls.

states.loading: Full-screen dark surface with a 'Negotiating connection...' terminal-style text loader.
states.empty: Session ended state with a large reconnect button.
states.error: Connection lost overlay with automatic retry countdown.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge landscape/portrait canvas. Implement a hideable/auto-fading floating widget overlay (surfaceSecondary, elevated via border/tonal contrast) for tools like disconnect, keyboard toggle, right-click, and quality toggle. Ensure touch areas are at least 44x44pt. Exclude bottom tabs from this view.

screens.name: SessionLogs
screens.purpose: Audit trail of all past connections and durations.

states.empty: Abstract document icon, 'No active sessions logged', no CTA required.

screens.layout: High-density data list. Use narrow rows with left-aligned timestamps (mono/display font), target device names, and right-aligned durations. Strip all unnecessary padding to fit more logs per screen.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage account, security preferences, and app options.
screens.layout: Standard categorized list layout. Group items logically (Account, Security, Session Defaults). Use Phosphor icons in a brandTertiary tinted rounded square for each row's leading visual.

hero_datacenter.alt: Abstract dark datacenter networking cables for hero background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility personality: use sharp contrast, tight spacing, and segmented controls. Avoid all visual softness like glassmorphism or oversized shadows.
NO BLUE OR PURPLE COLORS. Use the defined Warm Amber (#FF6D00) for active states, CTAs, and accents. Fallback to grey/neutral (#616161) for info states.

For the RemoteViewer screen, the control toolbar must be a floating overlay (absolute positioned) that can fade out or be hidden to preserve screen real estate. Use a toggle to switch between touch (direct manipulation) and mouse (virtual cursor) mode.
Use Rajdhani for metrics, Device IDs, and headers to create a command-center aesthetic, paired with IBM Plex Sans for body readability.
Ensure the RemoteViewer handles gesture disambiguation carefully; use specific gesture regions to translate local touch to remote input without triggering local navigation.
Implement the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 0 image, Layer 1 linear gradient, Layer 2 text) securely over the hero_datacenter image in the Auth screen.
For settings and list items, use the requested tinted icon container pattern: feature icons placed inside a brandTertiary-tinted rounded square.
